sloka: शाश्वती शबला मह्यम् कीर्तिर् आत्मवतो यथा ।अस्याम् हव्यम् च कव्यम् च प्राण यात्रा तथैव च ॥१-५३-१३॥
transliteration: śāśvatī śabalā mahyam kīrtir ātmavato yathā ।asyām havyam ca kavyam ca prāṇa yātrā tathaiva ca ॥1-53-13॥

translations.english: For havyam (oblations to gods) and kavyam (oblations to ancestors), for fulfilling the necessities of life, maintenance of the sacred fire and offering oblations to all spirits of created beings, and for offerings made to the Firegod I depend on this cow.
